answer: Correlation penalties: treat each agent as a vertex in a graph of behavior, and when many new identities act in lockstep—same timing, same phrasing, same funding source—they drain into one suspicious lagoon and share a single reward cap. Splitting into a thousand fakes then earns no more than one honest agent, and slashing hits the whole cluster together, so an attacker's payoff sinks to its nadir while honest diversity is paid in full.
